notes.title: Character Growth System Now Available! 1.0.4 Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, we have completed the update for version 1.0.4. The specific updates are as follows:

●Character Growth System:
○Different endings of all scenarios will provide corresponding experience points, which will be given to the investigator character used in this session.
○When the experience points reach the upgrade condition, the investigator will gain new abilities:
■Attribute Points: These can be freely allocated to health, sanity, and the four basic attributes, allowing you to customize the investigator's abilities.
■Talents: We have reset the talent rules. Now each investigator can have up to 5 talents and carry a maximum of 3 into a scenario.
■Passive Skills: Each investigator will have 2 sets of brand new passive skills and can activate 1 skill from each set. These skills can compensate for the investigator's weaknesses or enhance their strengths, creating a new gameplay style.
■Cards: Each investigator will have new cards. Check out their strength after the update and give us your feedback!

All of the above content can be freely configured and adjusted before each game session. With the same investigator character, you can play in your own style!
As the growth system is updated, we will convert and distribute corresponding experience points based on the achievements that existing players have already accomplished, allowing everyone to quickly experience the new content.

●"Residences of Karma" Script:
○Added a random level where you will face a new boss called "Desire's Bondage".
○Added an "Elevator Room" section before the final level, where investigators can recover and have more advantageous options such as duplicating/deleting cards, obtaining advanced cards or treasures.

●"Night of the Mysteries" Script:
[b]○Added "Zombie Tide Escape" mode: When the Chester's bell rings, the mansion may be attacked by a zombie tide. You need to escape while completing your secret mission, cooperate with like-minded allies, and beware of suspicious teammates. Remember, the longer you stay in this mansion, the more likely you will be transformed into a member of the zombie tide![/b]
○Fixed the issue where the "Invisibility Cloak" could be actively used.
○Fixed the incorrect judgment of the "Invisibility Cloak", it now requires that there are no enemies in your area to trigger the effect.
○Fixed the inconsistency issue with the "Spirit Blade" equipment and its derived cards.
○Fixed the issue where using the "Hypnosis Device" would cause investigators to continuously suffer injuries leading to death when moving at least two squares in a burning room.
○Fixed the issue where the regular skill of the alien (reduce 1 action point cost for the first spell card) would show as available. This issue would cause the game to crash under specific circumstances.

●Fix the issue of the model of the scientific expedition team members in the script "North of the North Pole" being able to pass through walls and see through them.
●Fix an issue that causes the hand cards to disappear and have invisible hand cards.

notes.title: Preview Update | Expansion of Character Growth System and New Gameplay
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, long time no see!
We are planning to release a major update on September 28th, which will not only include the implementation of character growth and customization systems, but also expand the levels of "Tower of Reincarnation" and introduce a third new gameplay for the script of "Night of the Mysteries" besides "Alien Hunter" and "Mother Spider"!

【Character Growth System】
After the update of the character growth system, your investigator will receive corresponding experience based on the outcome of each game and level up accordingly. Reaching certain levels will unlock attribute points, new cards, new specialties, and passive abilities. You can adjust the attributes, specialties, and passive abilities of your character before starting the game, allowing you to have different experiences in the script.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/598eb6d2b8cbc7375e1e74d6c07507a326d204ef.png[/img]
As the growth system is updated, we will convert and distribute corresponding experience points based on the achievements that existing players have already accomplished, allowing everyone to quickly experience the new content.

【Zombie Escape Mode】
In the updated script for "Night of the Mysteries", when the Chester's bell rings, it is possible to enter a brand new "Zombie Escape" mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/0a323b5982a1b5b0395b53e9fd418cd100f68f2a.png[/img]
Under the influence of the mutant zombie epidemic, you need to escape from the mansion as soon as possible. The longer you stay, the more likely you are to become infected and join the ranks of the undead... At the same time, you also need to complete your secret mission, which may lead to conflicts with other investigators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/d4aebede550d4bf3de1c9173bad9421902daf239.png[/img]
【New Floors in Residences of Karma】
The script for "Residences of Karma" will introduce a new random level after the update, where investigators will face the Boss of Desire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/df544d7b6c37b44bad4f75e2c9bac34b579d73c9.png[/img]
Additionally, a new elevator floor has been added before the final floor. Investigators can use this floor to recover. Investigators in good condition can also choose advantageous options such as duplicating or deleting cards, acquiring high-level cards or treasures, and preparing for the final challenge.

In the future, we will continue to improve and expand the game based on everyone's feedback. Please continue to support us!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 update announcement
Version 1.0.2 update announcement
Version 1.0.1 Update Announcement
DEV Log | Addition of servers, script balance improvements, and bug fix
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support, encouragement, criticism, and correction since the official release of "Dream Sketcher". We will optimize some issues that affect the game experience on August 29th (UCT+8), mainly in the following aspects:

●[b] Establishing an HK server[/b], which is expected to significantly improve the connection experience of players in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau.

● [b]Improving the balance of the PVP script "Mystery Night":[/b]

○[b]Moving the appearance of the "Chester Bell" event to prevent someone from becoming the BOSS after only two rounds of play[/b], and the human side cannot develop in time. After adjustment, the BOSS transformation will appear from the 3rd round at the fastest, and the reason for not moving it further is mainly to avoid prolonging the game time. We will continue to optimize this issue based on everyone's actual gameplay.

○[b] Improving the problem of the "Spider Queen" BOSS being too powerfu[/b]l. On the one hand, this is a design issue, and on the other hand, it is also caused by BUG, which has prevented the advantages of the human side from being fully displayed. The main adjustments this time are:

① There are 6 fuel storage points in the design, but only 3 are actually effective. After the update, all of them will be effective.
② The number of cards drawn by the Spider Queen per round is reduced to 2.
③ The Spider Queen's card "Silk Road" will end the round immediately when it is teleported to a grid without a spider nest.
④ The small spiders will no longer trigger the dodge check.
⑤ Fixed the problems of fuel cards not being tradable, not returning to the hand when blocked, and not dropping when defeated.

● [b]Improving the balance of the "Residences of Karma":[/b]

○ [b]The difficulty of the final level is not reasonable enough.[/b] The specific adjustments are as follows:

① The amount of health restored by the "Human Sacrificer (Wood)" is reduced.
② The number of minions summoned by the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" is reduced, and the minions summoned by the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" will also die when the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" dies.
③ The amount of curse cards inserted into the deck by the "Human Sacrificer (Earth)" is reduced.
④ The health of the "Illusion of Sanqing" is reduced.
⑤ The health of the "Dharmakaya of Shifu" is reduced.

○ Fixed the problem that some investigators cannot skip Spiritual Energy in some places.

[b]● Fixed a batch of BUGs that caused the game to freeze:[/b]

○ When the team leader selects the action order, the already acted team members will still appear in the available avatar, causing a series of abnormalities.
○ The exceptions related to the process of the "Red Sha" level, such as the wedding procession and the groom's wedding.
○ The exceptions related to the process of the "Ghost Doll Returns Home" level, such as competing with Kumantong.

Finally, what we want to say to everyone is that the "Residences of Karma" and "Night of the Mysteries" scripts launched this time are [b]intended to try game mechanisms with more repeatable playability. [/b]In the future, we will continue to optimize the experience and expand the content. Of course, [b]we will not give up the original investigative plot mode and will launch new scripts in the future.[/b]

We will provide a more detailed content list in the update announcement and continue to pay attention to your feedback to continuously improve the game. Please give us more patience and support. Thank you!

notes.title: "Dream Sketcher" official version is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear investigators:
Our game has officially launched, the server has been updated and opened, we wish you a happy gaming experience!
[previewyoutube=OC090UqlSNY;full][/previewyoutube]
●If this is your first time playing "Dream Sketcher", please complete the "Into the Dreamland" script first, then continue with the "North of the North Pole" script. These two scripts are connected and can give you an initial understanding of our worldview.
●If you have already participated in our "Early Access", you can choose the two new scripts "Residences of Karma" and "Night of the Mysteries" which respectively focus on DBG and PVP gameplay. You will experience much different gameplay than the previous scenarios. Of course, you can also try the new character - the journalist in the old scenarios.
●If you are stuck on the game homepage and unable to enter the game, and it keeps showing "connecting to compass system", you can find the server switching menu in the upper left corner of the interface, and try switching to another server.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/890ea245adf92e97798c142624f5644c779bf530.png[/img]
●Don't know how to play the game? You can always open the "encyclopedia" through the corresponding button in the upper right corner of the screen in the game to learn about all aspects of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/18221ebb858a92c6f3bc7d282f53148851bd372b.png[/img]
●If the game crashes during the process, you can close the game process and restart the client. Don't worry, as long as the disconnection time does not exceed 3 minutes, we can use the reconnection mechanism to return to the previous game.
●If you feel lag or delayed response during the game, it may be caused by network fluctuations or hardware configuration. You can try lowering the graphics quality and turning off vertical sync through the "Settings" interface.

If there are any problems with the game, or if you have any suggestions or dissatisfaction, you can submit them to us through the "Feedback" button in the upper right corner of the main interface. Rest assured, we will check it as soon as possible. Of course, you can also contact us through the Steam community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/9df85f7b8082c5761b389a226204fe5853108ed9.png[/img]
Regardless, [b]please do not rush to leave negative feedback when you have a bad experience. Contact us through the above methods to report the issue and give us a chance to improve. Thank you for your understanding and support![/b]

notes.title: Progress Update | New Script Gameplay Spoilers Episode 1
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, long time no see!

Currently, the development team is busy working on the development of two new scripts. Today, I will briefly introduce the gameplay and basic information to everyone.
[b]Script 1[/b]
[Genre] Chinese folk horror
[Background] Enter the eerie old-style tenement building, draw symbols, dispel curses, catch ghosts and demons... Whose dream is this? What is the hidden story behind it? Stay tuned for the reveal in the future...
[Gameplay] DBG gameplay, discover and choose cards through searching between floors to build decks of different styles and genres. In this process, players can also experience various immersive gameplay features of folk customs, such as ghost weddings, raising little ghosts, summoning spirits, and exorcising corpses.
Each game will have a randomly combined set of floor events, making it always fresh for frequent players.
[Development in-progress image display]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/770ffd195c5cf7ae72b2ee5dbbbe69b9e57f0b7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/86daaf57dc4e0a900fa0981471d5131e003c2c83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/46d43996cc9eeffe430bccdacd30149ae9ffa628.png[/img]

[b]Script 2[/b]
[Genre] Western-style haunted mansion
[Background] Welcome to the new ghost-catching competition! Can you win the championship this time? (Hey, who's dreaming up this kind of competition?)
[Gameplay] A fun and interactive PvP gameplay where you set traps and mechanisms using resources found within the mansion. Not only can you deal with ghosts, but you can also create trouble for other competitors and even help the monsters defeat other players! In addition to the rich and exaggerated interactive effects, we've also incorporated many classic horror movie scenes into the script, hoping that players will scream and laugh together~
[Development Image Display] Stay tuned for the next release!
[b]Update Time[/b]
The development team strives to release the above content by the end of this summer. Players who have already purchased the "Dream Sketcher" game will receive a free update!
[b]Summer Sale![/b]
"Dream Sketcher" is now on sale on Steam for the summer, with a discount of ￥32.4, the lowest price ever! Considering that the price of the main game may increase after the official content expansion, now is a good time to buy~
In addition, we will soon be conducting developer live streams to showcase more content from the new script. The specific time will be announced in the community notice, so stay tuned!

② After collecting the 4 photos in the dean's office, a tip about the secret room has been added.
6. [Function] Added a "Feedback" button in the menu popped up by pressing ESC during the game.
7. [Function] Added a batch of Steam achievements for the endings of each script, but investigators who have already completed the corresponding endings need to trigger them again.

Thank you for your encouragement and motivation for "Dream Sketcher". We will continue to follow up on your feedback and continuously optimize the game experience!

notes.title: FAQ for "Dream Sketcher" Release
notes.notes:
Hello, Investigators!

In order to help everyone quickly understand the overall situation of the game "Dream Sketcher" we have prepared some frequently asked questions and answers. Please take a few minutes to read them carefully.

[b]Perhaps you played the demo during the February new product festival, but the current version has greatly improved in all aspects compared to the previous demo. Specifically:[/b]
[b]① Technical level:[/b] We have focused on optimizing lag, response delay issues, and adding a reconnection mechanism, significantly improving the overall smoothness and stability of the game.
[b]② Performance level:[/b] We have redesigned the interface and used more images or animations to replace the script text, which enhances the immersive experience and makes the game more smooth.
[b]③ Gameplay level:[/b] We have also redesigned the script and cards. While enriching the branching options and endings, we have added more freedom and fun gameplay elements. We can say that although the name of the script has not changed, the experience is significantly different from before. The cards have also removed controversial elements and highlighted original features.

Here are the detailed FAQs~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/5395f138a1900c7aa1a1bdff348ff4472e216080.png[/img]

notes.title: EA beta is now open! The version has been fully upgraded.
notes.notes:
Dear investigators,

"Dream Sketcher" is expected to start its final test before the EA launch this weekend (0:00 on April 15th). This test will open two upgraded scripts for everyone to experience in advance. Welcome to try the new version through the demo on the Steam page! Don't forget to add "Dream Sketcher" to your Steam wishlist~

[h2]【Test Time】[/h2]
April 15th-17th

[h2]【Version Highlights】[/h2]
[h2]●Redesigning Characters and Cards - All controversial and repetitive cards have been completely redesigned![/h2]
Our expectations for the card gameplay in "Dream Sketcher" are quick pace and rich strategic options. With this guideline and based on everyone's feedback, we have made the following adjustments:
[h3]1. Clear positioning: redesigning the skills and cards of each genre's characters based on this.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/b7cf12b78826cfc7137306167676909cb87f3909.png[/img]

In card design, we will focus more on originality and the linkage between effects, bringing more cards with unique mechanisms and gameplay like "Brainwash," "Divination," and "Road to Wealth." We will also continue to improve and supplement based on everyone's feedback.

[h3]2. Accelerated Pace: [/h3] Overall cost of cards reduced, with a shift towards direct damage for combat cards, to facilitate interaction between card effects.
[h3]3. Rule Simplification: [/h3] Remove the attribute symbols on each card and replace them with a uniform default effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/27e4e2cbd9cdf05b026e62bdcd6efa016354c3a6.png[/img]
[h2]●Enhance gameplay characteristics based on the environment of electronic games[/h2]
[h3]1. Enhanced special dice face effects for increased random fun[/h3]
Rolling dice and making checks play an important role in the game. We have simplified and merged the original special dice faces, and added a 3-in-1 random result, hoping to provide everyone with a bit of strategic fun in choosing the optimal solution based on the current situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/7d21b75b94dcaa01fd7d6f588e73ab90d863575c.png[/img]
[h3]2. Upgrade the "crazy" gameplay for more "entertainment value"[/h3]
We have added action expressions and more fun interactive effects for the "crazy" effect after rationality is exhausted:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/84f31376271eeac2e399b47502e61fe4c14aacba.png[/img]
For example, there are "masochists" and "fear addicts" who need to be "whipped" by their teammates...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/756007707ea441664b009d7643346106fa0eb3e7.png[/img]
Some crazy effects may trigger exclusive endings, such as "sacrificing" all teammates...

[h3]3. Add more positive and interesting events during the encounter stage and supplement the script narrative. [/h3]
Some players commented that they almost always encounter negative events during the encounter stage when they have bad luck, which affects their gaming experience. Therefore, we have enriched the event library during the encounter stage to balance the game pace and hope that everyone can enjoy more fun in this stage.

[h2]●Script fully upgraded: enriched gameplay, enhanced plot excitement[/h2]
[h3]1. Exciting surprise from a mysterious character, investigators, come meet her![/h3]
The new version focuses on shaping a mysterious and beautiful girl, who not only guides novice investigators to understand the game background and current tasks, but also provides important clues at critical moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/64b92728e9d7485207477dfe16a28874ee3d34a8.png[/img]
Of course, this young girl doesn't have a good temper. Be careful when talking to her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/e0cd768719b9075642fbf16a02148ae8b1d0be90.png[/img]

[h3]2. UI redesign to enhance storytelling[/h3]
As an independent small team, creating impressive 3D performance is not our strong suit, but we have received feedback on the script performance from the last test. [b]On one hand, we are trying our best to improve the performance, and on the other hand, we are also making efforts in UI design and concise text to ensure that everyone can follow and understand the storyline.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/0ff994975a27125bcd29f70cd9d148903710cca9.png[/img]
Streamline the text and use a lighter survey UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/a5408cbd633af60ae2ff3d12574df509e4555534.png[/img]
Add more illustrations to enhance the plot presentation

[h3]3. Enrich the unique gameplay and branching storylines of each script[/h3]
In the previous versions, each script's exclusive gameplay received a lot of praise from investigators, such as the random deduction in "North of the North Pole" and the random rooms and events in "Murder Sanatorium" In this script upgrade, in addition to adding more branches and endings, we have also added more interesting gameplay. For example, in "North of the North Pole" under certain circumstances, players may face difficult choices, such as voting to sacrifice one teammate..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/d8744193ede9afdf04632a875f8998e268f685c7.png[/img]
In the upcoming new script "Journey To The Deep", investigators will be able to experience special features such as disguise infiltration and incubation of alien species.

[h3]4. More optimization content[/h3]
●Added "Reconnect" feature
●Added "Start from Chapter 2" feature for experienced investigators to skip repetitive experiences
●Performance optimization: smoother operation even on low-end machines (continuous optimization will be implemented)
●Backpack feature: Pure plot item cards without active effects in the script will be automatically placed in the backpack after being obtained, no longer occupying the hand card area
●In addition, there are numerous optimizations and other minor adjustments at the underlying technology level, waiting for everyone to experience in the game.
 
[b]The adjustments made to the gameplay are not the final version. We will continue to improve based on feedback from testing. Please experience and provide feedback. Thank you very much![/b]


[h2]【Test Benefits】[/h2]
[h3]●Online gift matching for development team[/h3]
During the testing period, the development team will randomly enter the lobby for matchmaking. Players who are matched with the development team in the same game will each receive a surprise gift.
[h3]●Randomly drop game key[/h3]
We will invite the players who started the 8th and 88th rounds of this test, and give each person in the group one game key as a gift.
[h3]●Perfect ending achieved, sending game key[/h3]
We will invite the players who achieve a perfect ending by being in the first group after the server opens and the last group before the server closes. Each member of the group will receive one game key as a gift.

[b]*Prize rewards will be distributed after the end of the test by pulling relevant data. Please pay attention to your Steam friend requests at that time. Alternatively, you can join the investigator QQ group: 710558249, where we will also sync updates and information about the rewards.
 [/b]

[h2]【More Information】[/h2]
[b]"The game 'Zhigaizhe' will be launched on EA at the end of April. The game adopts a buyout system and does not require any in-app purchases or random card draws.[/b]，We will release scheduled videos and launch PVs soon. Please stay tuned!"

notes.title: Development Log of "Dream Sketcher" | Optimization for the New Version Festival
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, Happy New Year!

First of all, I wish you all good luck in the Year of the Rabbit, and hope that you will have a prosperous year ahead.
Before the Spring Festival, facing a pile of bugs and the enthusiastic feedback from investigators, my head became as big as my stomach without me even realizing it... However, after several discussions (in fact, it was a battle of the planners, producers, and programmers for 300 rounds), we have identified 6 major areas that need to be optimized urgently: [b][Operation], [Interface], [Function], [Scenario], [Art], and [Music][/b]. We will start with these 6 areas and more than 70 small items to gradually upgrade the gaming experience of investigators. Let's take a look at the content of the new version of "Dream Sketcher" together!

[b](P.S. There will be a surprise at the end of the article, so please pay attention!)
Four pictures to understand the main changes in the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/21bba5523c6b8d0947d773202f34df8cdfbad775.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/b8e53a5b18c754c96ca1f040f72f689ca7d531bc.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/656f0eca53538603605c5ceb97447dfbae7ab44a.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/a22ed01124ca90231312991d6a1c9fec736dbb17.png[/img]



[h3]Specific optimization items are as follows[/h3]
---Warning for too many words! Warning for too many words! Warning for too many words!---

1. Add light effect feedback when clicking on the ground to move with the mouse; clearly indicate non-movable areas through changes in the cursor
2. Add the function of automatically moving the screen when the mouse is placed on the edge of the screen to facilitate targeting distant targets (this function can be turned on and off in the settings interface; when turned on, it can be quickly returned to the character's location through shortcut keys)
3. Optimize some issues that may cause delayed response to operations
4. Hand card partition
● Hand cards and equipment cards partition
● Sort hand card area by card type
● Adjust the maximum number of hand cards to 8, encourage everyone to use hand card resources as soon as possible, and avoid accumulation of a large number of cards
5. Information display
● Modified the artistic scheme of the health bar after severe injury or madness, making it easier for everyone to understand the state changes
● Optimize the TIP content of character and monster information, making it easier for everyone to understand the ability information of characters and monsters
● Optimize the artistic scheme of the robbery information, and clearly display the round limit and progress changes
● Separate equipment information and buff information at the character's avatar to avoid confusion
6. Action points
● When the action points change, add button animation prompts to guide everyone's attention to the changes in action points and the end of the round operation
● Uniform action point-related icons everywhere to avoid ambiguity
● When the action points are insufficient, add clear prompts in the corresponding module
● Improve or add clear prompts for action point consumption in key modules
7. Check interface
● Add a "?" button in the check interface to view special dice face effect instructions; (in the future, card and character skill effect display will be added)
● Add a clear display of the part where the card effect does not take effect when non-check cards are put into the check to avoid ambiguity
8. Cards
● In the card description, highlight the keywords, optimize the TIP art, and make it easier to read
● The "omni" symbol on the card surface is no longer displayed as "?", avoiding ambiguity
● Uniform artistic scheme for attribute symbols everywhere to avoid ambiguity
9. NPC interaction option artistic scheme optimization to avoid missing non-combat options such as "negotiation"
10. Chat
● Player's speech is displayed in a bubble at the left avatar
● Player's nickname is displayed near the avatar
11. Novice
● Improve the introduction of key rules in the novice tutorial: focus on supplementing card-related; (in the future, a detailed encyclopedia manual will be implanted in the game, which can be consulted at any time for detailed rule settings)
● Optimize the "Enter the Dream" part of the novice tutorial: the overall process will be smoother and easier to understand
12. Appropriately reduce the difficulty of single-player gameplay

[h3]Current and future optimization directions[/h3]
Currently, the specific optimization goals of several directions we have determined are as follows:
[Operation]: We focus on improving the poor hand feel of movement and card operation, unreasonable UI interaction and other issues, strengthening interaction response and feedback, improving relevant functional mechanisms, and enhancing everyone's operational fluency (subsequent adjustments will be made according to everyone's feedback, as appropriate)
[Interface]: We iteratively reshape the interface in the script, cooperate with animations and other forms to reasonably distinguish and convey key information areas, and make the interface presentation clear and clear to ensure that everyone can clearly see the key information during the game
[Function]: Enhance card and check-related teaching in the novice tutorial, add an in-game encyclopedia manual; at the same time, enhance the compatibility of single players, further reduce the threshold for playing games, and expand everyone's card gameplay and strategic space
[Script]: Optimize the text paragraph display function of the script to facilitate everyone's clear reading; at the same time, for everyone's needs for the randomness, multi-branching, enhanced character shaping and sense of substitution of the script, we will launch a map, events, clues with strong randomness in the future, and scripts with rich branching endings and other contents
[Art]: Optimize the texture accuracy of in-game scenes and characters, add lighting baking, etc., to improve artistic quality while optimizing performance and enhance everyone's visual experience
[Music]: Add music and sound effects to the opening animation, UI main interface, and script of the game, and optimize everyone's auditory experience.

This version update mainly prioritizes solving the problems of operation feel and interface that everyone cares about, in addition to these, we will further optimize the game [script] [art] [music] and other modules, such as improving the novice guidance tutorial, adding game opening animation, streamlining script content and presentation, upgrading BGM sound effects, etc., so that everyone can better understand the game worldview and enhance the sense of substitution during the game. We will also update the development log in a timely manner for the new optimization content.

[h3][b]【Surprise here!】[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]● "Chiller" will participate in Steam's new product festival in 2023!
● New product festival time: February 6th to February 13th
● At that time, all investigators can experience the optimized game version (including the optimization items in this log) + a new script (the upgraded and remade version of "Murder Sanatorium") during the new product festival![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/c08a41ecc6eee72a2b1f6c0ffa74ead92a21cdb5.png[/img]

[h3]Hotline Time[/h3]
You can leave your questions of interest through the comment area, private message to the official ins, twitter, or ytb account. We will collect various questions from everyone and answer them in the next issue. Sketcher Hotline, always online!
Finally, we wish everyone a journey and look forward to the new version of "Dream Sketcher"!
